title: Field3 Terminal Owner Adapters
objective: Implement authenticated C5/C6 unit and live-final owner adapters required by field3 C7 without answer fixtures

oracles: Existing authenticated C5, C6, exact factorback, relation, and class owners

handoff.summary: Adds strict immutable producers for the C7 unit and live-final schemas. The unit producer preserves C6 not_given honestly and requires exact factorback evidence on success; the live producer derives 301 principal records from exact relation/principal owners and copies class descriptors from the authenticated class suffix.
risks: The authentic 153088-bit owners were intentionally not run in this lane.
The relation and class serialization producers must use the documented field3-full-owner-authority-v1 and field3-live-class-suffix-owner-v1 interfaces when integration publishes the authentic run.
next_steps: Integrate after the C6 factorback verifier commit so the exact factorback schema is present.
Publish the authentic relation/class source owners, invoke both adapter operations, and feed the resulting hashes to C7.
Run broad repository gates in the integration lane after all active field3 work lands.
